CustomField.description: Fit and intent, 0–100: interest, learning done, seats, and whether they hold an account.
CustomField.label: Lead score
CustomField.formula: MIN(100, CASE(Academy_Interest__c, "seats", 40, "consulting", 30, "salesforce-setup", 20, 10) + MIN(30, Academy_Lessons_Done__c * 3) + IF(Seats_Requested__c >= 20, 20, IF(Seats_Requested__c >= 5, 10, 0)) + IF(ISBLANK(Academy_User_Id__c), 0, 10))
